Summary: SELECT from media_storage_file_storage when media DB storage is not in use or disabled
Custom field (Release Note): To reduce unnecessary database query overhead and eliminate noisy system exceptions, the media file synchronization layer has been optimized to bypass database storage checks when the system is explicitly configured to use the local filesystem

Summary: [Issue] module.xml file improvements for Magento_ConfigurableProductGraphQl, Magento_MsrpConfigurableProduct, Magento_NewRelicReporting & Magento_Swatches modules.
Custom field (Release Note): Optimized the module declaration architecture by removing redundant Magento_Catalog dependencies from four core sub-modules. This cleanup addresses unnecessary duplication in the dependency tree, streamline module loading order calculations, and improves long-term framework maintainability without introducing breaking changes.

Summary: Fatal error thrown on exception constructor when cookies store is an array
Custom field (Release Note):
Fixed an issue where an invalid store cookie value caused a PHP fatal error.
Magento now correctly throws an "Invalid store parameter" exception when the store cookie contains an invalid value.

Summary: Possible memory leak in getUsedProducts function for configurables
Custom field (Release Note):
Fixed an issue where processing multiple configurable products caused execution time and memory usage to increase over time.
Configurable products can now be processed without the progressive slowdown and memory increase.

Summary: Shop By Category filter visible on non-anchor categories
Custom field (Release Note):
Fixed an issue where the Shop By Category filter was displayed on non-anchor categories even when the category filter was disabled in Admin.
The filter is now hidden on the storefront according to the configured setting.

Summary: RMA - Add Return Comments API - Emails are triggered to Sender (Sales Representative) but not to Customer
Custom field (Release Note):
Fixed an issue where return comment emails sent through the Returns API were sent to the sales representative but not to the customer.
Customers now receive an email notification when a return comment is added through the API with customer notification enabled.

Summary: Add to Cart button within "Click for price" popup not working.
Custom field (Release Note):
Fixed an issue where the Add to Cart button in the "Click for price" popup on the product listing page did not add the product to the cart.
Products can now be added to the cart successfully from the popup.

Summary: Add to cart notification for related products
Custom field (Release Note):
Fixed an issue where the Add to Cart notification did not include the related product when adding a product and its related product together.
The notification now displays the names of both products added to the cart.

Summary: [Issue] Update js.phtml DOM text reinterpreted as HTML
Custom field (Release Note): To strengthen the platform's security baseline and minimize the risk of malicious input execution, the primary inline script template handling dynamic DOM updates has been refactored to eliminate cross-site scripting (XSS) injection vectors.

Summary: Wrong discount calculation when one of applied cart price rules has Discount Qty Step value
Custom field (Release Note):
Fixed an issue where the discount was calculated incorrectly when multiple cart price rules were applied and one rule had a Discount Qty Step (Buy X) value.
Discounts are now calculated correctly for all eligible quantities.

Summary: Minicart cannot be used twice in the same page
Custom field (Release Note): To provide frontend developers with greater layout flexibility, a long-standing core UI limitation has been resolved, allowing multiple minicart blocks (e.g., one in the header and another in the footer) to exist and update independently on a single page layout.

Summary: [Issue] Use static const in Magento\Customer\Model\Address\Config
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed an issue where custom address configuration classes had to duplicate getFormats() to use a custom address template path. Custom address configurations can now define their own template path using a static constant without duplicating the method.

Summary: [Issue] Fix import iframe visibility
Custom field (Release Note): To ensure a clean and polished user interface within the Magento Admin panel, a template layout defect has been resolved where an internal background execution iframe became visible to store managers during data validations

Summary: [Issue] Update CartRepositoryInterface.php
Custom field (Release Note): Updated CartRepositoryInterface.php to declare the exceptions that can be thrown when saving a cart. This keeps the interface consistent with the underlying cart save implementation.

Summary: [Bug] Company field in shipping address is set to null in multi-store setup when adding a new address during the checkout shipping step
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed an issue where the Company field was not saved when customers added a new shipping address during checkout in a multi-store setup. The Company value is now correctly saved in the quote, placed order, and customer address book.

Summary: Dashboard should show Last 7 days by default when aggregate data is used
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed an issue where the Dashboard showed Today by default when aggregated sales data was enabled. The Dashboard now shows Last 7 days by default when using aggregated data.

Summary: The config:show command doesn't work with partial paths in newer versions
Custom field (Release Note): The `config:show` command now accepts partial configuration paths, such as payment, and displays the configuration values under that path. Previously, running `php bin/magento config:show` payment returned an error: `The "payment" path doesn't exist. Verify and try again.` instead of showing the correct values.

Summary: Data Type of applied_rule_ids in Quote and Quote Item is different
Custom field (Release Note): To ensure absolute database schema consistency and prevent critical cart data mismatches on high-volume promotional stores, the data column tracking active promo definitions has been expanded across parent checkout structures.

Summary: Cannot use processFilter on product Collection
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed an issue where applying multiple filters to a product collection using FilterProcessor caused a PHP error. Product collections can now be filtered correctly using multiple filter conditions.

Summary: `[Order][REST]` sales_order_items product_options column missing data when order placed from rest api V1/orders or V1/orders/create endpoints
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed an issue where order items created through the REST API did not include complete product_options data. Custom option labels and relevant option details are now correctly saved for orders created through the REST API.

Summary: [Issue] Update GraphQL tests Client.php for case-insensitive substring comparation
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed an issue where GraphQL API tests did not recognize Set-Cookie headers when the header used different letter casing. The tests now correctly handle Set-Cookie, set-cookie, and SET-COOKIE headers.

Summary: Paypal > Customer data mismatch (prefix, firstname, lastname)
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed an issue where customer name details were mapped incorrectly during the PayPal SEPA checkout flow. Prefix, First Name, and Last Name are now populated correctly in the order without any mismatch.

Summary: Extremely slow WebAPI GraphQL functional tests
Custom field (Release Note): To optimize build delivery setups and accelerate continuous integration (CI) environments, a testing infrastructure bottleneck has been resolved by transitioning cache clearing behaviors from external system command calls to native in-process memory handling.

Summary: Incorrect free_shipping flag for virtual products
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed an issue where the free_shipping flag was set incorrectly for virtual products when multiple items were added to the cart. The flag is now correctly set for all items when the applicable free shipping rule is applied.

Summary: Unable to get product collection scoped `decimal` attribute if price is globally scoped
Custom field (Release Note): To ensure precise storefront pricing and attribute rendering on international setups, a core data collection bug has been resolved where store-specific decimal values were erroneously replaced by default global values.

Summary: [Issue] TypeError in Creditmemo\Validation\QuantityValidator caused by min() with string quantity
Custom field (Release Note): To stabilize financial logging pipelines and prevent API request failures during bulk automated order refunds, data type casting guardrails have been added to the internal sales credit memo factory and validation layers.

Summary: [Issue] fix: login form incorrect password label
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed an issue where the Password field on the customer login page had an incorrect label association. The password label now correctly targets the Password field, allowing it to be identified properly by automated testing tools.

Summary: Potential Indexer Performance issue for large catalogs - Bulk Insert & Locking Entire CL table to identity the latest version
Custom field (Release Note): To safeguard database performance on large enterprise-scale catalogs, the system database indexer pipeline has been hardened to parse scheduled data modifications in bounded batches, eliminating high-pressure database locks.

Summary: Incorrect handling of the GET params
Custom field (Release Note): To improve platform stability and safeguard the checkout funnel, a block-level input validation layer has been added to prevent malformed URL queries from crashing storefront product pages.

Summary: Cancel Order Observer not executed when scope is frontend or webapi_rest scope
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed an issue where canceling an order from the storefront or through the webapi_rest scope did not execute the cancel observer correctly. Gift card amounts are now restored to the customer's store credit when the order is canceled.

Summary: REST API Attribute Update fails without attribute_id
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed an issue where updating an existing product attribute through the REST API failed when attribute_id was not provided. The API now correctly identifies the attribute using the attribute_code from the URL and updates it successfully.

Summary: [Issue] Fix the product gallery tab when an image attribute label contains a single quote
Custom field (Release Note): To ensure a reliable and uninterrupted catalog management experience in the administration panel, a JavaScript formatting defect has been resolved that completely broke the backend product workspace interface

Summary: [Issue] Improve performance when resized image URL is accessed but does not yet exist.
Custom field (Release Note): To maximize asset delivery responsiveness, significantly reduce server disk I/O, and prevent severe server processor spikes, the catalog image generation subsystem has been optimized to handle missing media URLs strictly on demand.

Summary: Magento\SalesRule\Model\Plugin\QuoteConfigProductAttributes::afterGetProductAttributes getting triggered on all Cart Queries
Custom field (Release Note): To reduce database execution strains and eliminate unoptimized database hits during customer checkouts, the sales rule product configuration plugin has been optimized to execute conditionally and leverage caching structures.

Summary: [Issue] Performance Improvement
Custom field (Release Note): To eliminate unnecessary memory allocation and reduce runtime processing overhead, several core string manipulation routines have been refactored to utilize optimized PHP native behavior.

Summary: [Issue] Fix support for GLOB_BRACE on non-GNU Linux systems
Custom field (Release Note): To guarantee seamless deployment capability across lightweight virtualization environments, a critical path discovery bug has been fixed to fully restore execution support for systems utilizing non-GNU libraries, such as Alpine Linux Docker images.

Summary: Marketing params added back into query used for built-in FPC identifier creation
Custom field (Release Note): To improve cache hit rates and eliminate server performance regressions, a structural flaw has been fixed in the native built-in Full Page Cache (FPC) system where marketing and tracking query parameters were accidentally reintroduced into cache identifier signatures.

Summary: BundleGraphQL Resolvers Create Separate Deferred Product Instances, Defeating Query Batching (N+1)
Custom field (Release Note): To drastically accelerate API response throughput and minimize server overhead, the GraphQL resolution layer has been optimized to enforce true query batching for bundle products, eliminating performance-draining N+1 database leaks.

Summary: Cart Price Rule with limited usage is not applied when editing an existing order in Admin (e.g. "Uses per Customer = 1")
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed an issue where Cart Price Rule discounts with usage limits were removed when editing an existing order in Admin. The original discount is now preserved when the order is edited, even after the usage limit has been reached.

Summary: Add support for plain objects with promoted properties in message queue communication
Custom field (Release Note): To support modern PHP development practices and simplify asynchronous architecture workflows, the framework reflection engine has been enhanced to natively process Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) utilizing public, promoted, and readonly constructor properties.

Summary: [Issue] Fix: Real column type introspection skips unsigned/nullable processors, uses defaults
Custom field (Release Note): To ensure accurate system setup tracking, a database abstraction defect has been resolved where declarative schema verification commands perpetually reported pending modification changes for DOUBLE UNSIGNED columns lacking explicit precision or scale attributes.

Summary: [Issue] [PHPDOC] Fix functions orderComment in Magento\Sales\Model\Order
Custom field (Release Note): To eliminate strict typing restrictions, enhance static analysis accuracy, and improve developer experience under rigorous linting engines like PHPStan (Level 5 or higher), inline structural documentation blocks have been standardized within the sales order core subsystems.

Summary: [Feature] Support "disabled" state for individual select options in the admin config
Custom field (Release Note): To enhance backend form flexibility and provide developers with granular layout control, framework-level support has been introduced to mark individual option tags as non-selectable inside form elements.

Summary: ⚡ Performance: Missing memoization in StoreManager and plugin overhead in Store module
Custom field (Release Note): To drastically lower CPU execution strain and minimize unnecessary application memory churn, a critical configuration value caching routine has been implemented to intercept redundant store check processes.

Summary: [Issue] fix(pagecache): recognize PATCH as valid HTTP method in Varnish VCL
Custom field (Release Note): Magento's default Varnish VCL now recognizes PATCH as a valid HTTP method, so REST API partial-update requests (e.g. PATCH /rest/V1/products/:sku) are passed to the backend instead of being piped. This fixes PATCH calls failing or behaving incorrectly when Full Page Cache is set to Varnish.

Summary: [Issue] fix: remove dead openssl_free_key() code path in JwkFactory
Custom field (Release Note): To clean up structural tech debt and align cryptography tools with modern execution profiles, legacy resource-freeing hooks have been purged from the JSON Web Key utility backend.

Summary: [Issue] [Bug] GraphQL SearchCriteriaValidator not loaded — removed by module-graph-ql di.xml array override
Custom field (Release Note): To preserve robust query validation and enforce platform guardrails, a dependency injection (DI) configuration defect has been resolved where the SearchCriteriaValidator layer was being inadvertently disabled.

Summary: [Issue] PHPDoc correction spelling
Custom field (Release Note): To maintain high code quality standards and improve integrated development environment (IDE) code-hinting accuracy, structural cleanups have been applied to inline code documentation layers across the core framework modules.

Summary: [Issue] fix: hardcode xxh128 hash algorithm in product import
Custom field (Release Note): To clean up internal subsystems and leverage modern system optimization baselines, the product import component has been streamlined to use a single permanent hash algorithm.

Summary: [Issue] Replace all gad_* parameters in VCL
Custom field (Release Note): To eliminate performance regressions caused by dynamic ad campaigns, the application's caching layers have been updated to proactively ignore all Google Ads gad_* query strings. This prevents external campaign links from invalidating page caches and slowing down target pages

Summary: EAV Select and Multiselect attribute validation incorrectly rejects option labels with the value "0"
Custom field (Release Note): To improve data integrity and eliminate unexpected submission errors across customer and catalog forms, a validation flaw has been resolved where option labels containing the exact string value "0" were erroneously rejected by the EAV core framework

Summary: addProductsToCart throws errors on custom_attributesV2 if attribute code is model
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed an issue where addProductsToCart returned an internal server error when a product had a custom attribute with the code model. The custom attribute can now be retrieved correctly through custom_attributesV2.

Summary: FPT value in cart page and product page are different for same configurations for a simple product
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed an issue where Fixed Product Tax (FPT) values were displayed differently on product and cart pages for the same tax configuration. FPT values are now displayed consistently across the product, catalog, mini cart, and shopping cart pages.

Summary: strpos() expects parameter 1 to be string, array given | magento/module-eav
Custom field (Release Note): To protect storefront stability and deliver an uninterrupted customer discovery experience, a critical type-mismatch defect has been resolved within the advanced catalog search processing engines.

Summary: [Issue] Validate frontend input type for file uploads
Custom field (Release Note): Customer address file uploads now validate that the target attribute's input type is file or image before processing, so text and other non-file attributes cannot be abused as upload targets. Invalid upload attempts return a clear validation error instead of failing unpredictably or accepting disallowed file types.

Summary: [Issue] perf(di:compile): cache ReflectionClass instantiations in Type, Config/Reader and ClassReader
Custom field (Release Note): To significantly accelerate compilation times and maximize continuous integration (CI) deployment throughput, the internal dependency injection compiler backend (`setup:di:compile`) has been optimized to eliminate redundant PHP reflection cycles.

Summary: [Issue] Update Filter.php  to allow `{{block template="Magento_Module::path/to/template.phtml"}}`  and setting \Magento\Framework\View\Element\Template as default class
Custom field (Release Note): To simplify content creation and align CMS directives with template layout standards, the core markup tag processing system has been enhanced to support block declarations without an explicit class definition.

Summary: Sales order grid permanently stuck in stale status when async grid indexing is enabled due to tied updated_at timestamps
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed an issue where the Sales Order Grid could remain stuck with a stale order status when asynchronous grid indexing was enabled. The order grid status now correctly updates to match the current order status, including cases where multiple order updates occur within the same second.

Summary: Show an authentication error when Adobe Stock credentials are invalid
Custom field (Release Note): Admins now see an authentication error when Adobe Stock credentials are invalid.

Summary: Min qty validation error in admin panel for bundle products
Custom field (Release Note): To improve the backend ordering experience and remove functional blocks when generating manual quotes, a validation error has been resolved where child item parameters were evaluated incorrectly during admin order creation.

Summary: Regression: Non UTF-8 encoded URI component still throws "Unable to serialize value" in CatalogWidget on 2.4.7-p5
Custom field (Release Note): To eliminate critical rendering failures caused by bad production web traffic, the catalog widget block has been fortified to gracefully handle non-UTF-8 data sequences inside requested URLs.

Summary: Customer token generated on website A can be used on website B in website-scoped customer configuration
Custom field (Release Note): To enforce strict customer data isolation on multi-website instances, a security gap has been resolved in the GraphQL authentication layer where tokens were being incorrectly validated across separate boundaries.

Summary: [Issue] fix: update minimum PHP version check in bootstrap to 8.3
Custom field (Release Note): To prevent confusing runtime errors and improve developer installation troubleshooting, the native PHP environment validator inside the system bootstrap framework has been brought in line with the application's actual core requirements.

Summary: [Issue] perf(di:compile): memoize Interception Config scope reads during compilation
Custom field (Release Note): To dramatically speed up site deployments and automated backend compilation, the dependency injection compiler (`setup:di:compile`) has been optimized to eliminate redundant XML parsing operations.

Summary: Upgrade underscore.js to 1.13.8 for preventing against security vulenerability
Custom field (Release Note): The bundled Underscore.js library (lib/web/underscore.js) has been upgraded from 1.13.7 to 1.13.8 No configuration changes are required.

Summary: magento-composer-installer silently leaves setup/ (and other mapped dirs) unpopulated when a deploy destination is a symlink
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed an issue where magento-composer-installer could silently fail to populate setup/ and other Composer-mapped directories when the deployment destination was configured as a symbolic link. This could result in missing files and an incomplete Commerce deployment.

Summary: [Issue] Fix PHP 8.5 deprecation: Using null as the key parameter for array_key_exists()
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed an issue on PHP 8.5 where customer login during guest checkout failed due to a deprecated array_key_exists() call with a null key. Customer login now works successfully without generating the deprecation error.

Summary: `health_check.php` returns 500 when `igbinary` is installed and default file cache is used (Varnish 503)
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed an issue where health_check.php returned HTTP 500 when igbinary was installed with the default file cache backend. The health check now accepts valid cache configurations without an explicit backend key, preventing Varnish from marking the backend as unhealthy and returning HTTP 503.

Summary: Cache preload keys no longer need ID prefix when using Symfony Cache adapter
Custom field (Release Note): Preload keys (preload_keys) for the Symfony Cache adapter can now be configured without the cache id_prefix. Previously, following the documented configuration and including the prefix on each key (for example, 061_SYSTEM_DEFAULT) caused the keys not to be preloaded. You can now specify the keys exactly as the application requests them (for example, SYSTEM_DEFAULT), and Adobe Commerce applies the id_prefix automatically.

Summary: `Using null as an array offset is deprecated, use an empty string instead` when editing global design config scope
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed an issue where editing the Global scope under Content > Design > Configuration returned an HTTP 500 error on PHP 8.5 due to a deprecated null array offset. The Global design configuration now opens successfully without the error.

Summary: [Issue] fix: update gzip types and remove IE6 workaround in nginx config
Custom field (Release Note): To improve page load speeds and optimize network asset delivery, the fallback server configuration has been modernized to better support modern storefront components and remove legacy tech overhead

Summary: [Issue] Fix PHP 8.5 deprecation when category attribute has 'frontend_input' …
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed an issue where opening a category in the Admin panel caused an error on PHP 8.5 when a category attribute had frontend_input set to null. Category pages now open and can be edited successfully without the deprecation error.

Summary: [Issue] Replace deprecated PHPUnit assertions and test-stub configuration
Custom field (Release Note): Updated Magento 2's core unit test suite for future PHPUnit upgrades by replacing seven deprecated PHPUnit usages. The changes address `isType()` assertions and `with*()` configuration on test stubs—patterns that trigger deprecation notices in current PHPUnit versions and are slated for removal in PHPUnit 13 or later.

Summary: [Issue] Attempt to fix flaky graphql OrderStatusChangeDateTest.
Custom field (Release Note): To improve continuous integration (CI) reliability and reduce false-positive build failures, a race condition has been resolved in the WebAPI functional test suite. The GraphQL order status validation test (OrderStatusChangeDateTest) previously experienced intermittent failures due to subtle timing disparities between PHP memory and MySQL timestamps

Summary: Guest add-to-cart: mini-cart / customer-data "cart" section under-reports cart as empty despite item being correctly persisted
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed an issue where the guest mini-cart did not reflect items immediately after adding a product to the cart. The mini-cart counter and dropdown now correctly update, and added products are displayed in the cart as expected.

Summary: AJAX add-to-cart inline error messages lost role="alert" semantics
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed an issue where AJAX add-to-cart error messages were visible on the storefront but were not announced by screen readers. Add-to-cart errors are now displayed within an accessible role="alert" region for proper accessibility support.

Summary: placeNegotiableQuoteOrderV2 returns total.total_shipping = null for orders placed from a negotiable quote
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed an issue where placeNegotiableQuoteOrderV2 returned a null shipping total for orders placed from a negotiable quote with paid shipping. The API now correctly returns the shipping amount, matching the shipping charge included in the order total.

Summary: GraphQL order_date and comment timestamps return wrong calendar date under non-en_US locales (IntlDateFormatter misparse) — AC-14431 fix incomplete
Custom field (Release Note):
Fixed an issue where GraphQL order dates could show an incorrect calendar date for French and German locales.
Order dates and related comment timestamps now return the correct date and time.
Improved date formatting so GraphQL date values can be reliably parsed by applications.
Existing behavior for the en_US locale remains unchanged.

Summary: setup:upgrade is changing indexer mode to `save` from `schedule` slowing it down immensely
Custom field (Release Note): Resolved a long-standing issue where running bin/magento setup:upgrade would inadvertently change indexer modes from "Save on Schedule" to "Save on Save" and unnecessarily drop and recreate database triggers, drastically reducing downtime and preventing performance bottlenecks during deployments on large catalogs.

Summary: Customizable option labels, and customizble option titles cannot be saved when a user's role is limited to a certain scope
Custom field (Release Note):
Fixed an issue where customizable option labels and titles were reverted when edited by an admin user with access limited to a specific store scope.
The updated labels and titles are now saved correctly for the selected scope.

Summary: [GraphQl] products query price filter issues with net prices entered in adminhtml
Custom field (Release Note):
Fixed an issue where the GraphQL products query did not consider tax when applying a price filter.
The price filter now uses the displayed tax-inclusive price, so only products within the specified price range are returned.

Summary: Magento2 redirects to homepage instead of showing error with wrong menu declaration
Custom field (Release Note): To optimize the extension development workflow and ensure stable backend loading, a structural routing defect has been resolved where invalid admin menu declarations triggered silent browser loop failures instead of displaying actionable diagnostic messages.

Summary: Gift Card price is displayed incorrectly in wish list
Custom field (Release Note):
Fixed an issue where the minimum configured Gift Card price was displayed as $0.00 in the wishlist.
The correct minimum Gift Card price is now displayed on both the My Wishlist page and the Wishlist sidebar widget.

Summary: Missing key \"model\" in Wishlist value data
Custom field (Release Note):
Fixed an issue where querying wishlist details through GraphQL returned an internal server error.
The wishlist query now returns successfully without the "Missing key model in Wishlist value data" error.

Summary: di.xml array item gets replaced if later config used numeric key
Custom field (Release Note): To protect architectural data integrity and improve modular extensibility, a core bug has been resolved within the Dependency Injection (DI) XML parsing engine where array configurations using the numeric key "0" were silently overwritten or dropped during module compilation.

Summary: [Issue] Remove forbidden @author tag
Custom field (Release Note): To ensure strict alignment with core technical guidelines, an incremental code maintenance sweep has been completed to clean up inline resource documentation blocks across multiple system modules.

Summary: [Issue] Remove forbidden `@author` tag from `Magento_Catalog` (part 2)
Custom field (Release Note): To ensure full alignment with Magento's unified code delivery guidelines, an incremental cleanup pass has been executed to systematically strip out non-compliant file comments across core storefront resource models.

Summary: Visual Swatch is deleted when updating option through REST API
Custom field (Release Note): To protect catalog data integrity and streamline automated integrations, a bug has been resolved in the EAV Swatch management layer where existing visual or textual swatch values were inadvertently wiped out during standard option updates.

Summary: [Issue] magento/magento2: Add i18 translations to requestPasswordResetEmail and resetPassword GraphQL mutations
Custom field (Release Note): To ensure a fully localized headless storefront experience, internationalization (i18n) translation capabilities have been added to the customer account recovery API endpoints

Summary: Discard subsequent rules for shipping amount
Custom field (Release Note): To ensure accurate promotional pricing and strict compliance with configured discount rules, a flaw in the shopping cart price rules calculator has been resolved where lower-priority shipping discounts were incorrectly applied

Summary: Tier Price Storage Interface Delete Bug doesn't delete all Tier Prices
Custom field (Release Note): Resolved an issue in TierPriceStorage where deleting product tier prices across multiple websites failed to delete all prices by updating the price ID matching logic to account for the assigned website ID.

Summary: [QUANS] Can it be possible to display the customer email ID and name in the Customer KPI Table under Advanced Reporting
Custom field (Release Note): Adobe Commerce now includes the customer first, middle, and last name in the data exported to Advanced Reporting, allowing the Customer KPI Table to display the customer name. Previously, only an encoded customer identifier was exported, so merchants could not identify customers by name in Advanced Reporting.

Summary: [B2B] Purchase orders not auto-converting to sales order with ActiveMQ
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed an issue where consumers started by cron did not process messages when ActiveMQ was used with the STOMP protocol. As a result, auto-approved purchase orders were not converted to sales orders. Message processing for STOMP queues is now more reliable and consistent with the DB and AMQP queue implementations.

Summary: [Cloud] Correction of Outdated Existing ISO Subdivision Codes
Custom field (Release Note): Updated region codes for 13 countries to match the ISO 3166-2 standard. Previously, some region codes did not match the standard, which could cause issues with third-party integrations and international compliance. New regions added for Belgium, Colombia, Spain, France, Italy, and Latvia. Region codes updated for Austria, Colombia, Costa Rica, Germany, Estonia, Spain, Finland, France, India, Iceland, and Latvia.

Summary: Heavy INSERT on sales_bestsellers_aggregated_monthly
Custom field (Release Note): Improved performance for aggregate_sales_report_bestsellers_data cron.

Summary: CMS pages created for different websites are displaying wrong pages in frontend
Custom field (Release Note): Previously, in multi-website setups where the Website Restriction landing page cache key was not scoped per website, causing the wrong CMS page to be served on the secondary website storefront. The cache key in WebsiteRestriction/Controller/Index/Stub.php now correctly includes the current website ID resolved via the store manager.

Summary: Empty quote records are being created when customer visits a page
Custom field (Release Note):
Visiting product page on the storefront doesn't create empty quote records in some situations.
Previously an empty quote records were created when customer visits a product page on the storefront

Summary: [CLOUD] Gift card and related not sellable WF-1688
Custom field (Release Note): Product does not disappear when non-default stock/source is used and related (related or upsell or cross-sell) product is saved.

Summary: Lazy configuration implementation
Custom field (Release Note): Performance optimization that improves configuration loading performance by lazily resolving scoped system configuration data while preserving existing configuration behavior.

Summary: Duplicate orders created even though the error is triggered
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed an issue where orders could still be placed with an invalid customer address

Summary: Exports failure with configured AWS S3 storage
Custom field (Release Note): Product export now works correctly when AWS S3 remote storage is configured. Previously, exported files could not be written to S3 due to invalid path resolution in the storage driver.

Summary: Configurable Product's performance impact on checkout (totals-information, estimate-shipping-modules)
Custom field (Release Note): Before the fix, checkout requests such as totals-information and estimate-shipping-methods could become significantly slower for configurable products with many child products when the first salable child appeared late in the child list. After the fix, this performance degradation no longer occurs, and response times remain consistent regardless of the position of the first salable child.

Summary: Product details page  "Weight" attribute doesn't show unit suffix in "Additional Information" section
Custom field (Release Note): Fixes the issue where the Weight attribute on the Storefront product page displayed only a raw numeric value in the "Additional Information" or "More Information" section without the configured unit of measurement (lbs or kgs).

Summary: [Cloud] Issue adding multiple coupons to reorder
Custom field (Release Note): Resolved an issue where valid coupons were no longer applied to an order after an invalid coupon attempt failed. Now, if an invalid coupon is entered, any previously applied valid coupons will remain applied correctly.

Summary: Issue with USPS REST API, incorrect rates for Maximum Package Weight
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed incorrect shipping estimates when an order splits into multiple packages (for example, above "Maximum Package Weight"). The carrier now requests a rate for each package and totals the amounts, consistent with the legacy Web Tools flow.

Summary: Cart totals recalculated on every cart page view
Custom field (Release Note): Optimized cart totals requests on cart page. Cart totals recalculated twice on every cart page view.

Summary: Bundle product child item qty inconsistency in Frontend Order View
Custom field (Release Note): Storefront order details page will now show the total ordered quantity for each bundle product option. Previously, the quantity column for each child option showed the parent bundle's ordered quantity instead of the total quantity ordered per option.

Summary: HugeRTE editor blocks emojis - javascript validation failed
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed the issue where HugeRTE blocked saving content containing utf8mb4 emojis (e.g. 🔵⚪🔴) when editing inside PageBuilder content-type modals (Text, Banner, Slide). Previously, the wysiwyg validation config for these modal forms resolved `allowUtf8mb4` to `false`, causing the editor to reject 4-byte UTF-8 characters even on installations where the database fully supports utf8mb4.

Summary: Console errors in schedule update preview mode
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed the issue where the preview page for a staging update would fail to load correctly with JavaScript console errors when two updates shared the same start time. Previously, the signed preview URL used an incremented version ID that did not match the timestamp derived by the preview JavaScript, causing a signature mismatch and preventing the page from loading correctly in preview mode.

Summary: Related products are getting automatically removed
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed the issue where related products were not removed when a product's attributes changed and it stopped matching a Target Rule. Previously, the mview indexer failed to delete stale rule-product associations and emitted a PHP Warning (Undefined array key) during reindexing.

Summary: Restricted admin cannot delete customers post-upgrade
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed an issue where restricted admin cannot delete customers after upgrade, with a red banner at the top of the customer grid saying: "More permissions are needed to view this item."

Summary: GQL Quantity null while stock_status is IN_STOCK
Custom field (Release Note):
The quantity field in the products GraphQL query incorrectly returned null for products that were in stock on a custom MSI stock. The resolver was gating the response on the cataloginventory/options/not_available_message config value before fetching the actual stock quantity, and the XML default of this config (2 — "Not enough items for sale") caused null to be returned on any fresh store without an explicit admin override.
The check is now evaluated after the saleable quantity is resolved. null is returned only when the product has no available stock (saleableQty <= 0) and the store is explicitly configured with "Not enough items for sale". Products that are in stock always return their actual saleable quantity, regardless of this config setting. The config read is also corrected to use store scope so store-level overrides are respected.

Summary: Customer Address Attribute (EAV) City and Street validation rules conflicts with hardcoded validation rules.
Custom field (Release Note):
Fixed an issue where the city validator incorrectly rejected valid city names longer than 100 characters (database limit is 255), and where street addresses longer than 255 characters could be silently truncated in the database without    
  returning a validation error. Both validators now enforce limits aligned with the narrowest database column constraint across all address tables.

Summary: Bundle Product stock status inconsistency
Custom field (Release Note):
Previously, when a store admin manually updated the stock status of a bundle product from the Admin panel, the change was not reflected on the storefront for stores configured with multiple inventory sources. Customers would continue to see outdated stock status despite the admin's changes. 
                  
  This issue has been fixed. Bundle product stock status changes made in the Admin panel are now correctly propagated across all configured inventory sources and stock locations, ensuring customers always see the accurate stock availability on the storefront.

Summary: Product Alert Consumer ignores store scoped system/stmp/disable
Custom field (Release Note): Product Alert Consumer now accounts for store scoped system/stmp/disable setting.

Summary: Admin is logged out when viewing customers with large address books in customer edit page in Admin Panel
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed an issue when Admin is logged out when viewing customers with large address books in customer edit page in Admin Panel

Summary: Help on cleaning 59M+ quote tables (sales_clean_quotes is unable to run)
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed the issue where the `sales_clean_quotes` cron job timed out on instances with large quote tables. Previously, the cleanup query selected all columns from the `negotiable_quote` table unnecessarily, causing MySQL to perform a full filesort on millions of rows; and each quote was deleted individually via the PHP model layer, compounding the performance cost.

Summary: Orders do not appear in Sales Grid
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed an issue where new orders were delayed in appearing in the Sales grids when asynchronous grid indexing was enabled, due to the reconciliation cursor resetting once it caught up to the most recent entity. New entries now appear in the grid on the next cron run.

Summary: Order Rate Limit feature incompatible with Valkey cache backend
Custom field (Release Note): Previously to this fix rate limiting was silently bypassed and each request was allowed through regardless of the configured limit. After the fix, requests exceeding the configured limit are correctly rejected with HTTP 429.

Summary: Valkey LAYOUT cache keys consume a lot of space for a big products catalog
Custom field (Release Note): Previously, each product generated its own LAYOUT cache entry per store view, causing excessive memory consumption in Redis/Valkey on large catalogs. Now, LAYOUT cache entries are shared across products with the same type, attribute set, and store view, bounding cache growth regardless of catalog size.

Summary: [ASUS] OrderMutex::execute() missing DeadlockException retry causes permanent ShipOrder/InvoiceOrder failure-
Custom field (Release Note):
ShipOrder and InvoiceOrder operations now are successfully resolved in case of Deadlock.
Previously ShipOrder and InvoiceOrder operations fail permanently due to Deadlock

Summary: base_wee_tax_applied_amount is not set for parent product
Custom field (Release Note): base_weee_tax_applied_amount value is now populated for the configurable product in database tables like sales_order_item, sales_invoice_item, sales_creditmemo_item, not only for its child

Summary: Frontend compare page displaying incorrect Short Description label translations
Custom field (Release Note): Previously, on the Compare Products page, comparable attribute labels such as Short Description could display a translation from a different store view instead of the one for the current store. Now, the correct store-specific translations are displayed.

Summary: REST API allows negative product prices while Admin UI blocks them
Custom field (Release Note): Product import via the REST API endpoint now rejects negative values for price-type attributes (price, special_price, cost, and related MSRP fields), consistent with the behavior of the Admin UI import. Previously, the API accepted negative prices silently and persisted them.

Summary: Incorrect price shown for grouped product in Admin Create Order when two grouped products share the same simple product
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed an issue where the price of a grouped product in Admin Create Order was incorrectly calculated when two grouped products sharing the same simple product were both configured without being added to the cart.

Summary: [Feature Request] Clear redundant in store pickup data when changing shipping carrier
Custom field (Release Note): When switching from in-store pickup to home delivery method, the pickup location and associated store address are removed from the cart. A valid shipping address must be provided before the order can be placed.

Summary: [Cloud] Missing Assigned Products filter in Category Product Grid when Magento_VisualMerchandiser is enabled
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed the issue where the "Assigned" filter was missing from the Add Products modal Search All Products grid when Visual Merchandiser is enabled. Previously, admin users had no way to filter products by their assigned/unassigned status in that modal, making it difficult to identify which products were already in the category.

Summary: Incorrect FPT/WEEE row-level calculation on parent configurable items during invoice generation
Custom field (Release Note): Invoice and credit memo grand totals for configurable products now correctly include the Fixed Product Tax amount. Previously, the FPT row-level amounts were not propagated to the parent configurable order item, causing the invoice and credit memo totals to be lower than the order grand total by the FPT amount.

Summary: Page Builder product carousel ignores category position sort order, displaying products in entity_id DESC order instead
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed an issue where products displayed in a Page Builder carousel set to sort by category position appeared in the wrong order on the storefront. Products are now shown in the order configured in Admin → Catalog → Categories → Products tab.

Summary: Performance Regression and incorrect cache storage with SymfonyL2 enabled
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed an issue where configuring the L1 cache storage path as an absolute path (e.g., /dev/shm) caused it to be silently redirected to the var/ directory, and a separate performance issue where invalidating cache tags on large catalogs could cause significant response time delays due to a blocking Redis operation.

Summary: Bulk tier price API fails entire batch when one SKU is missing
Custom field (Release Note): Previously, the bulk tier price update API (POST /V1/products/tier-prices) failed the entire request when any SKU in the payload did not exist, leaving valid SKUs without updates. Now, valid SKUs are processed successfully while missing SKUs are reported as per-item errors, so a single bad entry no longer aborts the whole batch.

Summary: NoSuchEntityException "store that was requested wasn't found" thrown by GetStockIdForCurrentWebsite.php
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed the issue where visiting a storefront page with an invalid ?store= query parameter caused a NoSuchEntityException to be logged at CRITICAL level on every such request. Previously, the MSI stock data plugin passed the raw store code directly to StoreManager::getStore() without handling the case where the store did not exist, resulting in exception log clutter.

Summary: Setup:upgrade takes too long on Magento_CatalogStaging data patch with high number of storeviews and categories
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed an issue where the CE-to-EE data migration patch did not correctly migrate scheduled category design updates and product special prices into staging updates. Categories with scheduled design dates produced empty staging updates due to an incorrect staging context approach. Products were silently skipped on PHP 8.1+ when NULL datetime values were present from a previous migration run. Also improved migration performance by loading only affected categories and products instead of iterating the full catalog.

Summary: Indexers stuck in self-lock loop with 'use_application_lock' and 'file' provider
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed an issue where indexers hung indefinitely during reindexing when the indexer use_application_lock setting was enabled together with the file lock provider. Reindex operations now complete as expected.

Summary: [Cloud] Catalog price rule activation not reflected in Live Search until next force resync — price feed sync delay
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed an issue where activating a catalog price rule did not update prices in Live Search until a later force resync. The price feed indexer could run before the catalog rule indexer it depends on had finished, and so exported stale prices. Indexers with unfinished dependencies are now deferred to the next cron run, so the price feed always runs against up-to-date prices.

Summary: Product quantities modified on page refresh while creating order from admin
Custom field (Release Note): Resolved an issue where refreshing the page could cause the same SKU to be added multiple times.

Summary: Action Log does not display Return Number/Return ID for return-related actions
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed the issue where the Return Number/Return ID was not displayed in Action Log entries for return-related admin actions. Previously, actions such as viewing or saving an RMA were recorded in the Action Log without any return identifier, unlike order-related actions which correctly showed the Order Number.

Summary: Deadlock error on product query
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed an InnoDB deadlock on pages with a CatalogWidget Products List filtered by category, which occurred when the schedule-mode price indexer ran concurrently.

Summary: [B2B] Missing Bundle Option Prices in Quote Details After Quote Is Converted to Order
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed an issue where bundle product option prices were missing on the negotiable quote detail page after the quote was converted to an order.

Summary: [CLOUD] BundleProduct items.options.price ignores website-scoped prices when Catalog Price Scope = Website
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed Website-Scoped Bundle Option Prices in GraphQL: Resolved an issue where querying bundle product options via GraphQL returned global "All Store Views" prices instead of website-scoped prices when Catalog Price Scope was set to Website. The Magento\BundleGraphQl\Model\Resolver\Links\Collection resolver now properly checks price scope and joins website-specific selection prices based on the requested store scope.

Summary: Concurrent async email cron workers send duplicate order confirmation emails for the same order
Custom field (Release Note): Resolved an issue where concurrent email workers could send duplicate order confirmation emails for the same order.

Summary: [CLOUD] Adobe Commerce Cloud category rule OR operator logic issue
Custom field (Release Note): The Contains operator now accepts multiple comma-separated values, evaluated as an OR match. A single rule row can therefore match any of several terms instead of just one.

Summary: [Storefront] Add-to-cart "requested qty is not available" message intermittently not rendered on PDP
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed the issue where the stock unavailability message ("The requested qty is not available, please reduce the quantity.") was intermittently not displayed on the product detail page after a failed Add to Cart attempt. Previously, the page could refresh silently with no error feedback when a shopper repeatedly clicked Add to Cart for a product whose available stock was already fully reserved in their cart.

Summary: Fixed-amount category cart price rule discounts non-matching dynamic-bundle child when the rule matches the bundle parent
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed the issue where a fixed-amount cart price rule with a category condition incorrectly applied a discount to all children of a dynamic-price bundle when the rule matched only the bundle parent. Previously, bundle children that did not belong to the targeted category received a prorated share of the discount instead of zero.

Summary: Duplicate active cart created for customer due to concurrent customerCart GraphQL requests race condition
Custom field (Release Note): The system now ensures only one active cart is created per customer regardless of request concurrency. Previously, two concurrent customerCart GraphQL queries or POST /V1/carts/mine REST requests for the same authenticated customer with no active cart could result in duplicate active cart records in the database.

Summary: Customer Segment evaluation returns customers from only the first website instead of all assigned websites when Global customer sharing is enabled
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed an issue where Customer Segment evaluation returns customers from only the first website instead of all assigned websites when Global customer sharing is enabled.

Summary: "Use Default Value" unchecked for Price and Tax Class on Admin product save at store-view scope
Custom field (Release Note): Restricted admin users can now save products at store-view scope without losing the "Use Default Value" state for Price, Status, and Tax Class attributes. Previously, saving a product as a restricted admin (with price and status editing denied) would silently uncheck "Use Default Value" for those fields, causing store-view-level overrides to be written even when none were intended.

Summary: Persistent shopping cart cleared on natural session expiry when Clear Persistence on Log Out = Yes
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed the issue where the persistent shopping cart was cleared when the browser session expired. Previously, with Clear Persistence on Log Out enabled, an expired session emptied the cart and removed the persistent cookie even though the shopper had not logged out.

Summary: Slow performance with MAGENTO_DC variables set under cloud UI
Custom field (Release Note): After the fix, the deployment config is not reloaded each time the requested key is not present and some env variables are defined.

Summary: Content Staging Dashboard Catalog Price Rules grid displays duplicate data
Custom field (Release Note): The Catalog Price Rules grid now correctly displays the unique details for each Catalog Price Rule assigned to a staging update. Previously, when two or more Catalog Price Rules were assigned to the same staging update, the Catalog Price Rules grid on that update's page in the Content Staging Dashboard displayed the correct number of rows, but every row incorrectly showed the same (last) rule's data instead of each rule's own details.

Summary: Attribute update fails with label Value matching with existing Option value ID
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed the issue where a new dropdown/multiselect product attribute option could not be created via the REST API when its label matched an existing option's ID. Previously, the API returned an "already exists" error (and could return the wrong option ID) even though the same option could be created successfully through the Admin UI.

Summary: Category url_path not syncing on url_key change for all store views
Custom field (Release Note): Previously, changing a category's URL Key at the "All Store Views" scope could leave store-scoped descendant categories with a stale or incorrectly-prefixed url_path, and editing a category with its own store-specific url_path override could pick up its pre-edit URL Key instead of the newly entered one. This is now fixed — URL Key changes correctly cascade to all store-scoped descendants in the right hierarchical order with the correct parent path, and a category's own store-scoped url_path override is recalculated using its just-changed URL Key, so store-scoped URLs stay accurate immediately after saving.

Summary: Page Builder ajax preview request returns 500 error with translate cache disabled
Custom field (Release Note): PageBuilder preview now renders correctly regardless of whether the Translations cache is enabled or disabled. Previously, PageBuilder preview failed to render when the Translations cache was disabled.

Summary: [Cloud] Handled GraphQlNoSuchEntityException from QuoteGraphQl logged to exception.log, causing unbounded log growth
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed an issue where expected GraphQlNoSuchEntityException errors, such as those returned for an expired or invalid cart ID, were written to var/log/exception.log. These handled errors are still returned to the client as normal GraphQL error responses, but they no longer fill the exception log.

Summary: Import button remains available after validation errors when Validation Strategy is set to "Stop on Error"
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed the issue where the Import button was still shown in the validation results after a failed data validation when the Validation Strategy was set to "Stop on Error". Previously, the button appeared and could be clicked even though all records had failed validation, so the attempted import was immediately terminated.

Summary: [CLOUD] sales_clean_quotes cron job runs out of memory
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed the issue where the sales_clean_quotes cron job ran out of memory when cleaning a large number of expired quotes. Previously, the job retained every processed quote in memory and terminated with a fatal memory-exhaustion error before all expired quotes were removed.

Summary: [Quans] Adobe Commerce URL resolution query performance degradation
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed the issue where the GraphQL route query always rendered full CMS page content — including Page Builder widget execution and product collection loading — even when only URL routing metadata (relative_url, redirect_code, type) was requested. Previously, this caused unnecessary widget/product rendering and a significant increase in database queries per request for CMS pages containing Page Builder widgets.

Summary: [CLOUD] Malformed URL path returns HTTP 500 instead of 404 in URL rewrite router
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed the issue where a malformed storefront URL returned an HTTP 500 error page instead of a standard 404 Not Found. Previously, certain malformed request paths caused an uncaught error during URL rewrite resolution.

Summary: Admin Customer Edit performance tanks when Customer Account Sharing is set to Global
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed a performance issue on the Admin Customers Edit page where load time and HTTP response size grew quadratically when Share Customer Accounts was set to Global.

Summary: Add to Cart event payload is in the legacy Universal Analytics Enhanced Ecommerce format instead of the GA4 ecommerce format.
Custom field (Release Note): Before the fix, ecommerce events sent to Google Analytics 4 through Google Tag Manager used the legacy Universal Analytics format and were missing several checkout events. After the fix, all ecommerce events use the correct GA4 format and the full checkout funnel is tracked.

Summary: [CLOUD] PHP 8.5 compatibility — ComponentRegistrar::getPath() null array offset crashes setup:static-content:deploy (compact strategy) on 2.4.9
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed an issue where `setup:static-content:deploy` failed on PHP 8.5 with a "Using null as an array offset" error when compiling module LESS files that use the //@magento_import directive. Static content deployment now completes successfully on PHP 8.5.

Summary: Guest quote customer_email not resynced from billing address after restoreQuote() when retrying checkout
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed an issue where retrying a failed guest checkout placed the order with the previously entered email instead of the updated one.

Summary: [CMS] False-positive "Invalid HTML content provided" when saving CMS block with an anchor href followed by another attribute
Custom field (Release Note): CMS content containing a standard anchor link (e.g. `<a href="https://example.com/page" target="_blank" rel="noopener">`) no longer triggers a false "Invalid HTML content provided" validation warning or a save failure when cms/wysiwyg/force_valid is enabled.

Summary: Alt text (label) is not saved for a newly added product image
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed an issue where the alt text (label) of a newly uploaded product image was not saved when the uploaded file was renamed on save due to a filename collision in the media gallery. Previously, the image role attributes (image, small_image, thumbnail) were stored correctly, but their corresponding *_label attributes were silently dropped, leaving alt text empty on storefront search and listing pages. The gallery create handler now resolves the renamed file back to its originating image entry, so the label is persisted for all assigned image roles. As a result, alt text entered during product creation is reliably saved and rendered across the storefront.

Summary: [CLOUD] customer_group_excluded_website are not honored by the Catalog Permissions indexing pipeline
Custom field (Release Note): Catalog Permissions index now excludes the website that is excluded from the customer group.

Summary: The Quote GraphQL API may assign currency objects instead of ISO currency codes to quote fields
Custom field (Release Note): Updated the Quote GraphQL API to assign ISO currency codes to a quote's store and quote currency fields instead of assigning currency objects.

Summary: Animated GIF uploads are converted to PNG when Enable Old Media Gallery is enabled
Custom field (Release Note): Fixed an issue where animated GIF images uploaded through the media gallery were converted to PNG when the legacy media gallery was enabled. Previously, when Enable Frontend Resize was turned on, animated GIFs uploaded through the Old Media Gallery lost their animation and were saved as static PNG files. Animated GIFs are now uploaded and stored in their original format.

Summary: GraphQL: store ID passed as website ID in ProductStock::isProductAvailable causes 'website ... wasn't found' error
Custom field (Release Note): Previously, some storefronts could encounter a website wasn't found error when checking product stock availability while adding items to the cart, due to the store ID being used where a website ID was required. This has been fixed so stock availability checks use the correct website context, preventing the error.

Summary: PHP 8.5 "null as array offset" deprecation error opening Add Product page in admin when user lacks Edit Product Status resource
Custom field (Release Note): Previously, admin users without the "Edit Product Status" permission could encounter a "null as array offset" deprecation error when opening the Add Product page. This has been fixed so the page loads correctly regardless of the user's product status permissions.
